div.head: Foreword
div.p: This book should have been written long ago, since the material it builds upon has been available for the last 50 years and the nefarious trends it documents have been at work in our culture at least since the War. Yet Academia has become less and less able to produce a book such as this one as it sunk deeper and deeper into the myriad stifling rules of what it considers to be "cheating" from the perspective of the over-specialized hyper-scholastic modern day "researcher". "Big picture" investigation is now, for all practical purposes, forbidden. Nowadays, the "peer-review" gatekeeping would almost certainly reject a text such as this one. It was not submitted it to any traditional Academic publication channel, since doing so almost certainly have been futile.

Despite the sorry state of contemporary Academia, its erstwhile principles remain valid. This book tries to follow them. Its subject matter is at the crossroads of History, Sociology, Psychology and Theology (the latter term to be preferred to the ugly "religious studies"). It deals with the history of Christianity, and its role in shaping Western Culture, not from a Christian apologetics point of view but from the vantage point of hindsight, attempting to determine what Christianity genuinely consisted in and what its results were. In this area, it primarily follows Max Weber. In many ways, this work could legitimately be said to fall within the ambit of "Gender Studies". It is indeed about gendered notions and their impact on culture at large. Unfortunately, we all know the bias that hides behind the pseudo-neutral name of this discipline. A long time will pass, no doubt, before Gernder Studies departments accept this text as part of their canon.

This book is not a work of pure scholarship. It attempts to answer a specific question: how to understand the Cornell 7 case and the vexing issue of Campus frat orgiastic sex, which has keept on erupting in repeated "scandals" over the last five decades. What is exactly at work here? We bring to bear the multi-factor approach mentioned in the previous paragraph in an attempt to build as comprehensive an explanatory framework as the available and relevant scholarship make possible.
